source_engines: ZCode (GLM) weekly pipeline compilation from live ESPN endpoints (Weeks 1-4 finals, Week 5 scoreboard, post-Week-4 AP + AFCA Coaches polls, ESPN core season leaders, and the CFB Hub schedules dataset). Every number traces to those payloads; nothing is guessed. Composite = average of AP + Coaches ranks (unranked = 26). Remaining-SOS is a CFB Apex computed metric: average current win percentage of remaining FBS opponents (through Week 4 results), rank 1 = hardest.

storylines.mover: florida-gators moved to 4-0 with a 52-28 dismantling of then-No. 9 Ole Miss — the weekend's most lopsided ranked-vs-ranked result — and now sit AP #8 with a chance to keep climbing at No. 25 Missouri.
storylines.watch_next_week: ohio-state-buckeyes (AP #5, 3-1) at iowa-hawkeyes (AP #14, 4-0) — the week's top ranked-versus-ranked showdown; the loser's playoff margin is close to gone before mid-October.
storylines.weaker_than_record: georgia-bulldogs are 4-0 and No. 2, but the resume is soft so far: no ranked win, a 45-17 escape marked as the closest call, and a CFB Apex remaining-SOS rank of #107 — the softest remaining slate among the top ten.

outside_reference.fpi_top5: ESPN FPI (post-Week-4 table reported by Yahoo Sports, Sept 27): 1 Georgia, 2 Notre Dame, 3 Ohio State, 4 Texas, 5 Miami (FL). Note: FPI's No. 1 (Georgia) differs from the polls' No. 1 (Texas).
outside_reference.championship_futures: DraftKings futures as carried by ESPN (no same-day timestamp exposed, treat as current snapshot): Ohio State +600, Notre Dame +700, Indiana +750, Texas +750, Oregon +800.
outside_reference.field_convergence: Early post-Week-4 CFP projections converge on Texas, Georgia, Notre Dame, Miami, Ohio State, Indiana, Alabama, Florida, BYU and Boise State as the core field, with material disagreement on the final SEC and Big Ten slots (ESPN/FOX/Athletic projections via the Sept 27-28 research pass).
